question: An engineer must reduce TCAM usage in a Cisco ACI fabric while ensuring that all EPGs within a VRF consume the same set of contracts/services. Which action accomplishes this goal?
options: Configure a preferred group per EPG.
Disable policy enforcement on the bridge domain.
theory: Applying a contract to vzAny (the VRF-wide 'any EPG' construct) lets every EPG within that VRF share the exact same set of contract rules using a single set of hardware TCAM entries, instead of programming a separate contract/filter entry for every individual EPG pair - directly reducing TCAM consumption while still guaranteeing that all EPGs in the VRF consume identical services. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 18 - Cisco ACI Contracts, Apply/Remove VRF Contracts / vzAny)
